motivation_disclosure: The prior random observed-cell transfer was inspected. Causal forward-fill minimized probability drift, but severe random loss degraded the frozen operational-policy TSS. This experiment is therefore a realism check, not an independent recovery-method selection test. All prior simple recovery arms are retained.
block_placement: deterministic equally spaced score-row positions at 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% of the admissible start range; no labels or outcomes used; blocks within a scenario must not overlap
cell_eligibility: hide only cells that were genuinely finite/observed before the synthetic outage; pre-existing unavailable cells remain unavailable and are never counted as hidden truth

evaluation.primary: paired change in TSS at frozen clean threshold
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: complete NEW-crossing event episode or quiet block
evaluation.selection_rule: report every modality x duration x recovery-arm scenario; no scenario may be omitted based on outcome

claim_boundary: Development-only realism diagnostic on already-inspected score identities. It may motivate a DEGRADED/ABSTAIN policy but cannot validate that policy, establish locked-test robustness, operational certification, physics advantage, company superiority, economic savings, award outcome or breakthrough.
